title: Graceful retirement and migration playbook for feature-flagged model variants
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Playbook to retire feature-flagged model variants with minimal disruption. This covers technical migration shims, opt-in migration flows, per-customer runways, release notes cadence, and cross-functional runbooks for Support, Sales, and SRE. The goal is to provide a predictable timetable, automated compatibility fallback, and clear upgrade paths for both self-serve and enterprise customers.
acceptance_criteria: Customer-facing migration guide published and linked in Console help
Automated compatibility shim deployed to route fallback to compatible variants
Support runbook with triage steps and escalation matrix reviewed by SRE and Support
Release notes template and one-week cadence for targeted customers verified by GTM
Telemetry events and metrics defined to track migration completion and error rates
rollout_timeline: T-8 weeks: Publish internal migration timelines, notify account teams for tiered customers
T-6 weeks: Add migration banner in Console for affected models and start collecting opt-in list
T-4 weeks: Open public migration guide + per-region compatibility matrix; create sample PRs and SDK snippets
T-3 weeks: Enable compatibility shim in read-only mode (logging only) to detect incompatible calls
T-2 weeks: Start gradual enforcement for non-enterprise customers with 7-day rollback window
T-0: Official sunset enforcement and automatic redirection for pinned compatible variants
Post-sunset +2 weeks: Final audit, remove legacy kernels from serving pool if error rates < 0.5%
comms_plan: Internal: Weekly sync with Eng, Design, Support, Legal, Sales; distribute FAQ and support templates
Customer: Tiered email cadence - 6w notice, 3w reminder, 1w final notice, enforcement day summary
Console: Inline migration banner linking to guide and per-customer runways for enterprise accounts
Docs/SDKs: Code snippets for migrating prompts, tokenization notes, and example compatibility flags
Release Notes: Add section 'Variant Retirement' in runtime-1.20 release notes with migration link
Postmortem: Publish migration metrics dashboard and lessons learned 2 weeks after enforcement
notes: We are prioritizing a compatibility shim over immediate code changes in most SDKs to reduce churn.
Design directive: ensure migration banner is dismissible only after customer acknowledges migration steps.
PM decision 2025-02-25: give enterprise customers customizable runways up to 90 days by request.
Trade-off: shim adds 5-8% p95 latency for routed fallback calls; mitigation: only route on errors or unsupported ops.
Follow-up: measure prompt-output drift on migrated models using evaluation harness; baseline due T-1 week.
last_activities: 2025-02-22: Initial scoping with Runtime and SRE; decided on staged enforcement and shim approach
2025-02-28: Draft migration guide posted to Drive; requested early review from Support
2025-03-03: Design provided banner mockups and accessibility review notes
2025-03-07: Eng spike to validate shim compatibility completed; performance impact within acceptable bounds
